desc:
Wheel UP!
---
🔥 Chain tricks and bank your best runs
🌆 Explore one open city with a connected highway
👥 Create a crew and organize rideouts
💵 Earn cash by riding and unlock new bike customization
🏍️ Switch between electric bikes, supermotos, and powerful sport bikes
---
PC CONTROLS
WASD — Ride
SPACE — Wheelie
S — Brake / rear brake
V — Camera
T — Stand on the pegs
H — Hide HUD  
---
Mobile touch controls supported.
Your bike. Your style. Your crew.

(THIS GAME IS IN OPEN BETA, EXPECT BUGS & LEAVE FEEDBACK PLS)
